name: obsidian-read-aloud
description: Transform Obsidian notes into listenable spoken scripts via local/CLI AI harnesses and read them aloud with GPU-accelerated local TTS or Web Speech.

scripts.package: npm test && npm run build && mkdir -p release/read-aloud && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css versions.json release/read-aloud/ && cd release && zip -r read-aloud-0.1.0.zip read-aloud
